newsitem.title: USA: Dotronix Q2 loss mounts as demand wanes.
newsitem.headline: Dotronix Q2 loss mounts as demand wanes.

text.p: Dotronix Inc said Wednesday a larger-than-expected seasonal slowdown in demand for large screen color displays pulled revenues sharply lower in the second quarter and helped cause a loss in the period.

The company said revenues in the quarter ended December 31 slid to $2.2 million from $3.1 million and it lost $209,407, or $0.05 a share, in the period. Dotronix posted net income of $75,300, or $0.02 a share, a year ago.
Revenues are expected to continue at lower levels through the second half of the fiscal year, the company said.
Dotronix makes high resolution video displays.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 at 1-1/8.
